data.description: Replace the always-clean runInspection verdict with real checks on the deliverable HTML that CAN fail: viewport/overflow at 390px, missing nav/hero, external/broken refs, oversized media. On fail, surface the issue + auto-fix (revision) then re-check. Makes the hired-agent QA genuinely evaluative like the hiring-agent review.
data.title: Make the hired-agent QA pass real

data.body: REVIEW (pass): /api/qa renders deliverable in headless Chrome (puppeteer-core + system Chrome), screenshots desktop+mobile, Claude vision (claude-sonnet-4-6) critiques. Verified: flawed page -> issues w/ 6 specific findings (empty hero, low-contrast CTA, void cards, placeholder footer, mobile grid collapse, emoji-slop); clean page -> pass; realistic overflow build -> issues + mobileScrollWidth 1320. Live in-flow run: QA ran in the pipeline and reported a genuine vision observation. Coherence fix: major finding forces 'issues'. Fallback to in-browser measure when headless/vision unavailable (Vercel degrades gracefully). tsc clean. Approve.
